recognize_zh: 拼圖中的異常前骨髓球細胞質內，可見多條細長桿狀的 Auer rod 交錯成束，像一捆柴（faggot cell）；細胞質充滿粗大的紫紅色嗜苯胺藍顆粒，核常呈不規則或雙葉狀。成束 Auer rod 加上粗顆粒，是高顆粒型 APL（M3）的典型表現，應立即安排 PML::RARA 檢測。
features: Large abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse purple-red azurophilic granules
Multiple Auer rods arranged in crossing bundles or stacks (faggot cells)
Nuclei round to irregular or reniform, sometimes obscured by granules, with a visible nucleolus in some cells
Cytoplasmic granules extend to the cell border with some granule spillage
Background dominated by abnormal promyelocytes with few normal maturing cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear, composite of high-power fields, shows sheets of abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm densely filled with coarse azurophilic granules and round to irregular nuclei. Several cells contain multiple Auer rods arranged in bundles, forming characteristic faggot cells. Normal maturing myeloid and erythroid elements are sparse. Findings are consistent with hypergranular acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent confirmation of PML::RARA and coagulation assessment for DIC are recommended.

ddx.vs: t(8;21) AML shows single long slender Auer rods, perinuclear hof and salmon-colored granules, not bundles of rods in hypergranular promyelocytes.
Reactive promyelocytes have a perinuclear Golgi hof, orderly maturation and never contain Auer rods.
M3v shows bilobed nuclei with sparse or dust-like granules and few Auer rods, whereas this is the hypergranular form with obvious faggot bundles.

ddx.dx: APL-like AML with RARA variant partners (e.g., ZBTB16::RARA)
ddx.vs: Variant RARA translocations can look similar, with ZBTB16 cases showing regular nuclei and fewer Auer rods, so molecular testing is required and ATRA response differs.
